CURRENT QUESTION:
block wise how many loans are overdue and what percent of that block's loans is that, worst block first
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH BlockOverdue AS (
  SELECT
    Block,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Repayment Status = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS OverdueLoans
  FROM shg_loan_register
  GROUP BY
    Block
), TotalLoans AS (
  SELECT
    Block,
    COUNT(*) AS TotalLoans
  FROM shg_loan_register
  GROUP BY
    Block
)
SELECT
  b.Block,
  b.OverdueLoans,
  CAST(b.OverdueLoans AS DOUBLE) * 100 / t.TotalLoans AS PercentageOfOverdue
FROM BlockOverdue AS b
JOIN TotalLoans AS t
  ON b.Block = t.Block
ORDER BY
  b.OverdueLoans DESC;
```
